name: Humayun's Tomb & Qutub Minar Heritage Trail
description: Guided exploration of UNESCO World Heritage Mughal architecture, Persian water gardens, and the towering 12th-century minaret.

name: Chandni Chowk Old Delhi Culinary Safari
description: Tasting adventure through ancient alleys tasting crispy stuffed parathas, jalebis, kebabs, and kulfi at legendary century-old eateries.

name: Amber Fort Royal Tour & Sheesh Mahal Mirrors
description: Explore the majestic hilltop Amber Palace, intricate glass mosaics of Sheesh Mahal, and grand courtyards overlooking Maota Lake.

name: Hawa Mahal & City Palace Royal Museum
description: Witness the iconic 953 honeycomb pink sandstone windows of Hawa Mahal and the royal armoury inside the Maharaja's Palace.

name: Nahargarh Fort Sunset View & Rajasthani Thali
description: Panoramic golden sunset over the entire Pink City skyline from the fort ramparts followed by an authentic Dal Baati Churma feast.

name: Taj Mahal Sunrise VIP Guided Experience
description: Beat the crowds at dawn as morning rays illuminate the pristine white Makrana marble and lotus pools of the world's greatest monument of love.

name: Agra Fort & Mehtab Bagh Sunset Panorama
description: Walk through Emperor Shah Jahan's palace pavilions and capture reflective evening photos of the Taj Mahal from across the Yamuna River.

name: Lake Pichola Private Sunset Boat Cruise
description: Glide across serene waters passing the floating Taj Lake Palace and Jag Mandir island under glowing crimson desert skies.

name: Udaipur City Palace & Crystal Gallery
description: Marvel at Mewar dynasty royal artifacts, mirror mosaics, colored glass balconies, and the grand museum overlooking the lake.

name: Fort Kochi Heritage Walk & Chinese Fishing Nets
description: Stroll past St. Francis Church, Dutch colonial villas, street art murals, and watch local fishermen operate huge cantilevered shore nets.

name: Traditional Kathakali & Kalaripayattu Show
description: Watch intricate green-face makeup transformations followed by dramatic classical story-play and ancient martial arts demonstrations.

name: Kolukkumalai Sunrise 4x4 Jeep Safari & Tea Trail
description: Rugged off-road journey to the world's highest organic tea plantation (7,900 ft) for a breathtaking cloud-bed sunrise and orthodox tea tasting.

name: Private Backwater Houseboat Day Cruise with Sadya
description: Exclusive wooden Kettuvallam boat cruise across palm-fringed canals, serving freshly prepared Karimeen fish fry and 24-dish Kerala banana-leaf feast.

name: Grand Island Scuba Diving & Dolphin Catamaran
description: Boat expedition with dolphin spotting, guided coral reef scuba dive with PADI instructors, underwater video, and beachside BBQ.

name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter Heritage & Bakery Walk
description: Walk among colorful pastel Portuguese villas with wrought-iron balconies and taste warm Bebinca and Poee bread at historic bakeries.

name: Gateway of India & Elephanta Rock Caves Ferry
description: Scenic Arabian Sea ferry ride from Gateway of India to 5th-century rock-cut Shiva cave temples, followed by chai at the iconic Taj Palace.

name: Pangong Tso High-Altitude Lake Camp & Stargazing
description: Drive across Chang La pass (17,590 ft) to the 134-km color-changing saline lake, with nighttime Milky Way astrophotography and luxury dome glamping.

name: Dashashwamedh Ghat Evening Ganga Aarti by Boat
description: Witness the mesmerizing ritual of towering brass fire lamps, Vedic chanting, and floating flower diyas directly from a wooden boat on the sacred river.

name: Burj Khalifa Top of the World (Level 124 & 125)
description: Ascend the world's tallest building in high-speed double-deck elevators for jaw-dropping 360° views across the desert, city, and Persian Gulf.

name: Red Dune 4x4 Desert Safari, Camel Ride & BBQ Dinner
description: Thrilling Land Cruiser dune bashing in Lahbab desert, sandboarding, falcon photography, followed by Tanoura dance and BBQ buffet camp.

name: Chao Phraya River International Buffet Dinner Cruise
description: Sail past illuminated Wat Arun and Grand Palace on a luxury cruise ship with live band, seafood buffet, and panoramic river nightscapes.

name: Grand Palace & Wat Pho Reclining Buddha Tour
description: Marvel at golden spires, the sacred Emerald Buddha, and the monumental 46-meter gilded Reclining Buddha with mother-of-pearl feet.

name: Gardens by the Bay (Cloud Forest & Supertree Rhapsody)
description: Walk under the world's largest glass greenhouse with indoor waterfall and watch the magical musical light show in the futuristic Supertree Grove.

name: Ubud Jungle Swing, Tegalalang Terraces & Waterfall
description: Soar over tropical palm canopies on the famous giant swing, hike lush emerald rice terraces, and refresh under Tegenungan waterfall.

name: Eiffel Tower Summit Access & Seine Sunset Boat
description: Ascend to the very top deck of the Eiffel Tower at golden hour followed by an hour-long illuminated boat cruise past Notre-Dame and Louvre.
